nodes.title: **Features of ZX Bank Gold Loan**
nodes.summary: Gold loan features: fast processing with walk-in disbursal, minimal paperwork, and instant approval; gold jewelry stored securely in bank vaults; flexible repayment with choice of tenure; and digital tracking and repayment via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app.

nodes.title: **Interest Rate**
nodes.summary: Gold loan interest starts at 9.5% per annum (floating, subject to change), with a processing fee of 0.25% of the loan amount or ₹250, whichever is higher; actual rates vary based on gold purity, market rates, and loan amount.

nodes.title: **Maximum Loan Amount**
nodes.summary: Maximum gold loan amount is up to ₹50 lakhs in India and equivalent local currency up to the regulatory maximum in Sri Lanka, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh, with a loan-to-value (LTV) of up to 75% of the gold's market value per RBI regulations.

nodes.title: **Documents Required**
nodes.summary: Documents needed for a gold loan: identity proof (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License), address proof (Aadhaar, utility bill not older than 3 months, or Passport), a recent passport-sized photograph, and the gold jewelry or ornament to be pledged (hallmarked jewelry only).

nodes.title: **How to Apply**
nodes.summary: Apply for a gold loan by visiting any ZX Bank branch with gold ornaments and documents, or apply online via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app for a digital pre-approval and appointment; the loan amount is credited in minutes after gold valuation and documentation.

nodes.title: **Contact Us**
nodes.summary: For more information, visit www.zxbank.asia or use the ZX Bank Asia mobile app to chat with the Zia AI assistant; loan approval is subject to gold assay, purity, and documentation verification.
